Cheat Sheet Guide



Table 1: Common functions cheat sheet











Operation
R (dplyr/ Base R)
Python (pandas)
Helpful Notes




Inspect types
glimpse(df) / str(df)
df.info() or df.dtypes
.dtypes has no parentheses


Select columns
select(df, a, b)
df[['a', 'b']]
Requires double brackets [[]]


Filter Rows
filter(df, a > 5 & b < 10)
df[(df['a'] > 5) & (df['b'] < 10)]
Must use & and warp conditions in ()


Range filter
filter(between(a, 5, 10))
df[df['a'].between(5, 10)]
Inclusive on both ends by default


Distinct count
n_distinct(df$col)
df['col'].nunique()
Don’t use .count()


Frequency table
count(df, col)
df['col'].value_counts()
Returns counts per unique value
